# Atmospheric audio — CC0

Verified against the original publisher pages on 2026-11-12. All three recordings are offered under Creative Commons Zero 1.0 (CC0). No account, paid purchase or Asset Store package was used.

| Project file | Work / author | Source and original download | Derivative |
|---|---|---|---|
| wind.wav | wind1 — Luke.RUSTLTD | https://opengameart.org/content/wind1 ; https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/wind1.wav | First 48 seconds, 900 Hz low-pass, 2 second circular overlap; 46 second mono loop |
| drone.wav | ambient sound creepy — DaGameKnower | https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-sound-creepy ; https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/ambientmusic.mp3 | First 48 seconds, 220 Hz low-pass isolates low drone, 2 second circular overlap; 46 second mono loop |
| creak.wav | Wood Creak Single V1 — Rudmer_Rotteveel | https://freesound.org/people/Rudmer_Rotteveel/sounds/502505/ ; https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/502/502505_4921277-hq.mp3 | Public HQ preview decoded to mono PCM; 0.987 seconds |

All derivatives: 22050 Hz, 16-bit mono PCM, peak normalized to 0.7. Runtime beds at 0.075/0.10, timber at 0.095 with 21–36 second spacing after the first 16 seconds. No extra musical score.

Reproduce with `python Tools/Fetch-Atmosphere.py` from the repository root (requests, beautifulsoup4, numpy, ffmpeg). Full publisher downloads and HTML evidence remain in ignored Tools/asset-cache/atmosphere; login-form HTML is not redistributed. CC0 legal code is included in CC0-1.0.txt.
